93:t_2:45.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Yes, yes! Let this $$ノノ$$ go first...」

93:t_2:47.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「I'm $$ニコラス・バセロン$$. Please call me $$ニコラ$$.」

93:t_2:48.en:
$$カシオ$$
「I'm $$カシオ・タカシロウ$$. You can leave $$バスターマシン$$ maintenance to me.」

93:t_2:49.en:
$$チコ$$
「I'm $$チコ・サイエンス$$. It's nice to meet you.」

93:t_2:50.en:
$$ラルク$$
「I'm $$ラルク・メルク・マール$$.」

93:t_2:51.en:
$$チコ$$
「Introduce yourself properly, Princess. You're the ace with the highest kill count of all the $$トップレス$$.」

93:t_2:52.en:
$$ラルク$$
「We don't need to talk about that.」

93:t_2:53.en:
$$ノノ$$
「You're amazing, Big Sis! You really are the strongest and the best!」

93:t_2:54.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Enough already. Hurry up and introduce yourself.」

93:t_2:55.en:
$$ノノ$$
「I'm $$ノノ$$! I'll be joining $c starting today!」

93:t_2:56.en:
$$ノノ$$
「I'm single and in my prime! A maiden with dreams! I'm still a $$フラタニティ$$ trainee, but I'll do my best with effort and guts!」

93:t_2:59.en:
$$ノノ$$
「...It looks like that fell flat.」

93:t_2:60.en:
$n
「N-no, it didn't! You're just a little different from the other members...!」

93:t_2:61.en:
$n
「Oh... That's actually refreshing, and we were dumbfounded... I mean, surprised...」

93:t_2:62.en:
$$スズネ$$
「$n... You don't have to try so hard to cover for her...」

93:t_2:63.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I give you credit for trying a role you're not used to, though...」

93:t_2:64.en:
$$チコ$$
「She's an android. Maybe that's why she's a little different from us.」

93:t_2:67.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Hehe... I'm embarrassed to admit it.」

93:t_2:70.en:
$$宗介$$
「But I understand how $$オックス$$ feels.」

93:t_2:71.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Yeah. I sure wouldn't feel right calling her a tin can.」

93:t_2:72.en:
$$ノノ$$
「P-please don't stare so much. You're making me blush...」

93:t_2:73.en:
$$ラルク$$
「I don't know how it works here, but androids have certain rights in our world.」

93:t_2:74.en:
$$ラルク$$
「I won't let you lay a hand on her.」

93:t_2:75.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Big Sis...! You stood up for $$ノノ$$!」

93:t_2:76.en:
$$ラルク$$
「I just hate the way lecherous men stare.」

93:t_2:77.en:
$$チコ$$
「That's our Princess. Being the ace brought you attention from men all over the world.」

93:t_2:79.en:
$$アルト$$
「Their teamwork doesn't seem very good...」

93:t_2:80.en:
$$ノノ$$
「That's not true! We're $$フラタニティ$$, united by unbreakable bonds!」

93:t_2:81.en:
$$ラルク$$
「You're still a trainee, though, $$ノノ$$.」

93:t_2:83.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「That makes us part of your team now. We look forward to working with you.」

93:t_2:84.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「I've got a question! Are your robots called $$バスターマシン$$s too?」

93:t_2:86.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Someone we know also pilots a robot called a $$バスターマシン$$.」

93:t_2:87.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Its name is $$ガンバスター$$! ...Have you heard of it?」

93:t_2:89.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「That person fought $$宇宙怪獣$$, too.」

93:t_2:90.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Could you tell me more? I've been curious about enemies with the same name, $$宇宙怪獣$$, existing here.」

93:t_2:91.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Then you should ask $$ノリコ$$.」

93:t_2:92.en:
$$ノノ$$
「$$ノノリリ$$!? Is $$ノノリリ$$ here!?」

93:t_2:93.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「It's $$ノリコ$$, not $$ノノリリ$$.」

93:t_2:94.en:
$$勝平$$
「What's this $$ノノリリ$$ you're talking about?」

93:t_2:95.en:
$$ノノ$$
「She's the space pilot $$ノノ$$ admires. She's so beautiful, so wonderful, and so strong...」

93:t_2:96.en:
$$ノノ$$
「And I hear she had an incredible figure.」

93:t_2:97.en:
$n
「Oh, then she's someone different from the $$ノリコ$$ we know.」

93:t_2:99.en:
$n
「A-anyway...! You should meet $$ノリコ$$ sometime. Then you'll know.」

93:t_2:101.en:
$$アルト$$
「Unfortunately, we don't know where she is, either.」

93:t_2:102.en:
$$甲児$$
「But knowing her, she's probably fighting $$サイデリアル$$ somewhere.」

93:t_2:103.en:
$$ノノ$$
「I understand. $$ノノ$$ will keep giving life her all, looking forward to the day she meets $$ノリコ$$!」

93:t_2:104.en:
$$ルカ$$
「Given the Exotic Maneuvers, though, $$ノリコ$$'s $$ガンバスター$$ and your $$バスターマシン$$s were probably built with different technologies.」

93:t_2:105.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「So it's a parallel-world thing, with no particular connection to $$ノリコ$$...」

93:t_2:106.en:
$$正太郎$$
「'$$ガンダム$$'s exist in all sorts of worlds too. $$バスターマシン$$s and $$宇宙怪獣$$ are probably the same.」

93:t_2:107.en:
$$宗介$$
「So $$バアル$$ exists in every world...」

93:t_2:108.en:
$n
「But the forces that can fight it are coming together, too.」

93:t_2:109.en:
$$スズネ$$
「That's right. Let's treasure these new connections.」

93:t_2:110.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「We will soon rendezvous with the forces on $$蒼の地球$$.」

93:t_2:111.en:
$$テッサ$$
「They have also succeeded in strengthening their forces.」

93:t_2:113.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Once we reach $$蒼の地球$$, we will begin preparing to capture $$ラース・バビロン$$, the $$新地球皇国$$'s capital.」

93:t_2:114.en:
$n
「The final showdown with $$サイデリアル$$...」

93:t_2:115.en:
$$ランド$$
「Heh... I'm itching to get started.」

93:t_2:116.en:
$n
「Just wait, $$サイデリアル$$... We'll pay you back for everything you've done to us... to everyone on Earth.」

93:t_2:117.en:
$$ニコラ$$
($$蒼の地球$$... the $$新地球皇国$$... $$サイデリアル$$...)

93:t_2:118.en:
$$ニコラ$$
(I'll put in whatever effort I need to there. But with this unit, I'll get information on parallel-world $$宇宙怪獣$$ and $$バスターマシン$$s...)

93:t_10:4.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「So you're $$ＡＧ$$... I see why everyone was surprised when they saw $$ノノ$$.」

93:t_10:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「We both have lovable bodies, you know.」

93:t_10:6.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「They're lovable in very different ways, though.」

93:t_10:7.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「At least I don't think anyone would swoon over you as a cute robot girl.」
